text: Fifty years is the term and you served it out, which few do and fewer intend to. They gave you a dinner. Most of the men who could have spoken about the early years were dead, so a younger man spoke instead, from the record, and got the dates right and everything else wrong. There is a house, and an income, and no great deal of time.

The colony was lost and an inquiry was convened, as is customary, and concluded — as is also customary — that the causes were various. You gave evidence for a morning. There is a house, smaller than the last one and in a duller county, and an annuity that arrives on the quarter day. The Crown's losses were entered in a column and the column was ruled off. Nobody entered anyone else's.
